cutoverPolicy.bookingEnabledRule: BOOKING_ENABLED=true is no-go until every required gate is PASS or explicitly owner-approved as ACCEPTED_RISK or CONFIG_READY_NOT_DRILLED.
cutoverPolicy.trafficSplitCanaryPolicy: Cloud Run traffic-split canary is not used as PASS evidence for Phase 26. Phase 26 uses CI/CD green, 100% direct deploy, and a 15-minute strict watch.
cutoverPolicy.secretPolicy: Evidence must be redacted. Do not store raw Toss keys, payment keys, QR tokens, cookies, OTP values, or PII in this ledger.

gates.failureReason: Direct deploy strict-watch evidence has not been recorded.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Strict watch must cover health, auth/session, public detail, booking-disabled behavior, queue entry, and payment-safe path.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Rollback on health 5xx, login/refresh failure, public detail 5xx, unsafe booking side effects, queue entry 5xx, or unsafe payment confirm behavior.
gates.redactionNotes: Store revision IDs, timestamps, redacted HTTP statuses, and sanitized log summaries only.

gates.failureReason: Current active locale smoke has not reconciled older five-locale wording with code.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Verify active public locales and locale-prefixed route behavior during M1 smoke.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Do not mark M1 smoke PASS if an active locale route or switcher path regresses.
gates.redactionNotes: No cookies or user identifiers in locale smoke evidence.

gates.failureReason: Admin Gate Ledger/cutover readiness surface is not available yet.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Operator must be able to inspect gate state, evidence freshness, blockers, and disabled final enablement reason.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Do not proceed to live enablement if operator cannot inspect current no-go state.
gates.redactionNotes: UI/API must expose sanitized ledger data only.

gates.failureReason: Confirmed payment QR visibility is a known cutover blocker until fixed and verified.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Verify payment complete page and My Page/ticket detail QR access after confirmed payment.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Close booking if confirmed payment succeeds but QR issuance or visibility fails.
gates.redactionNotes: Do not store raw QR token, JWT, HMAC secret, or ticket bearer payload.

gates.failureReason: Toss test-key ticketing rehearsal has not completed.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Rehearsal must cover queue, seat lock, reservation prepare, payment-safe branch, QR issuance, refund/cancel, and cleanup.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Do not rely on live cutover readiness if test-key rehearsal fails or remains incomplete.
gates.redactionNotes: Do not store raw Toss keys, payment keys, order IDs, or customer details.

gates.failureReason: Exposed Toss test secret was not rotated during this execution window; owner approved continuing as non-PASS accepted risk with redacted CLI binding evidence.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Keep BOOKING_ENABLED=false until final cutover checks. During rehearsal, use only dedicated test event/order markers, redacted logs, webhook re-query verification, and immediate close-booking/rollback criteria for payment or QR mismatch.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Do not enable live booking if Toss test rehearsal fails, live-key smoke is unavailable, webhook re-query mismatches provider state, or secret leakage is detected in frontend/logs/artifacts.
gates.redactionNotes: Raw Toss client, secret, and security keys are not stored. Evidence records only key class, short redacted prefixes, Secret Manager version metadata, GitHub secret names, and Cloud Run binding names.

gates.failureReason: Toss live-key smoke is unavailable until review/live keys are ready.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Live keys must be injected with BOOKING_ENABLED=false before payment-safe smoke and final enablement.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Do not enable booking if live key prefix, server-only handling, widget init, confirm/query/cancel, webhook re-query, or leakage scan fails.
gates.redactionNotes: Record key class/prefix and command shape only; never raw keys.

gates.failureReason: Final booking-enabled readiness check has not run.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Validator must prove every required gate is PASS or explicitly owner-approved non-PASS before BOOKING_ENABLED=true.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Close booking immediately on financial or seat safety criteria.
gates.redactionNotes: Final evidence must be sanitized and must not include provider secrets or PII.

gates.failureReason: 10k baseline load gate has not run.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Record p95 latency under 2 seconds and error rate under 1 percent, or record approved accepted risk.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Do not open live booking if baseline load fails without accepted-risk approval.
gates.redactionNotes: Load evidence must use dedicated test identifiers and redacted auth.

gates.failureReason: 20k stress load gate has not run.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Record p95 latency under 2 seconds and error rate under 1 percent, or record approved accepted risk.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Do not open live booking if stress load fails without accepted-risk approval.
gates.redactionNotes: Do not load real Girl Rules users, orders, payment paths, or seats.

gates.failureReason: Cloud Run rollback drill/evidence is missing.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Record rollback target, current revision, safe command shape, and strict watch trigger mapping.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Rollback on direct deploy strict-watch critical failure.
gates.redactionNotes: Revision IDs and command shapes are allowed; no auth headers or cookies.

gates.failureReason: Cloud SQL PITR/restore path evidence is missing.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Actual safe-target restore is preferred; otherwise classify as CONFIG_READY_NOT_DRILLED or ACCEPTED_RISK with rollback trigger.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Do not execute destructive cleanup without backup/restore-point confirmation.
gates.redactionNotes: No SQL row dumps, PII, or credentials.

gates.failureReason: Valkey reconnect/failure behavior evidence is missing.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Record health, reconnect, queue/seat-lock impact, and sanitized logs.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Close booking if queue, lock, or seat safety signals fail after Valkey disruption.
gates.redactionNotes: Redact redis URLs, auth headers, cookies, JWTs, phone numbers, and customer data.

gates.failureReason: DB pool sizing/pgBouncer preparedness evidence is missing.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: If not drilled, this must remain CONFIG_READY_NOT_DRILLED or ACCEPTED_RISK, never PASS.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Close booking or rollback if DB pool saturation causes payment, queue, or seat safety failures.
gates.redactionNotes: Config summaries only; no connection strings.

gates.failureReason: HA/read replica preparedness evidence is missing.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: If not drilled, this must remain CONFIG_READY_NOT_DRILLED or ACCEPTED_RISK, never PASS.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Close booking or rollback if database failover/read capacity risk affects live booking safety.
gates.redactionNotes: Resource names and config class are allowed; no credentials or row data.

gates.failureReason: Cloudflare WAF/rate-limit active-rule and smoke evidence is missing.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Record normal-pass smoke and low-volume suspicious challenge/block/rate-limit evidence without impacting real users.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Close booking or tighten controls on traffic-defense bypass, queue abuse, or booking mutation abuse.
gates.redactionNotes: Redact rule IDs if needed; do not store IP addresses tied to real users.

gates.failureReason: One-person on-call playbook dry-run evidence is missing.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: PG/DB, Valkey, Cloud Run, Cloudflare, Toss/payment failure, queue stuck, and oversell-risk procedures need dry-run/log-query evidence.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Close booking when financial or seat safety triage cannot be completed quickly.
gates.redactionNotes: Runbook evidence must use sanitized command shapes and summaries.

gates.failureReason: First-2h and first-24h monitoring cadence/runbook is missing.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: First 2 hours: 5-10 minute checks. Until 24 hours: 30-60 minute checks.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Close booking on duplicate sale, payment/reservation/QR mismatch, payment failure spike, seat side-effect mismatch, queue stuck, or refund/cancel job failures.
gates.redactionNotes: Business metric evidence must aggregate or mask customer data.

gates.failureReason: Dedicated test-event cleanup isolation, dry-run counts, denylist, and restore-point evidence are missing.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Cleanup must be constrained by dedicated test IDs, test order prefix, test marker, and backup/restore-point confirmation.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Stop cleanup if dry-run returns unexpected rows or real production records.
gates.redactionNotes: No real Girl Rules row IDs, real user PII, payment keys, or full SQL row dumps.
